headline: Football world pays homage as Lionel Messi retires from Argentina national team
summary: Fans and teammates worldwide expressed profound gratitude and sadness following the superstar's announcement, calling his 20-year international career 'extraordinary' and 'eternal'.
details: The football world on Monday paid homage to Argentine superstar Lionel Messi after his decision to retire from the national team. The announcement left fans and teammates alike feeling bereft, with many expressing profound sadness and gratitude.

Teammates shared emotional messages, with one stating, "It's so hard to read that we won't see you in the sky blue and white anymore. I only know that I was born in the right century to be able to see you, enjoy you, and on top of that, to share all these years with you on the national team."

Another tribute read, "Just thank you, the greatest of all time, thank you for making us so, so happy, you can't imagine how many smiles you brought!! You are eternal." Many echoed sentiments of eternal love and admiration for his contributions.

His international career spanned 20 years, inspiring millions and redefining the beautiful game. Messi's remarkable journey included 207 matches for Argentina, scoring 125 goals and providing 68 assists.

headline_marked: [[Two dead in Times Square stabbing]] as police shoot knife-wielding woman
headline: Two dead in Times Square stabbing as police shoot knife-wielding woman
summary: A woman stabbed one person to death and injured another in New York's Times Square before being fatally shot by police. The second victim is in stable condition.
details: A knife-wielding woman fatally stabbed one person and injured another in New York's tourist-filled Times Square on Monday. The assailant was subsequently shot and killed by police at the scene.
Mayor Zohran Mamdani confirmed the two deaths during a press conference. He stated that the second victim, who sustained injuries, is currently in stable condition at a hospital.

Local news reports indicated that the suspect was taken to the hospital in critical condition following the police shooting. Authorities reportedly do not believe the stabbing incident was terror-related.

An AFP journalist at the scene observed a significant presence of emergency services and officials inspecting a patch of blood in Times Square. A witness told local outlet PIX11 that the suspect had two knives and was tased by police before rushing at officers.
The New York Police Department described the incident as a "confirmed officer-involved shooting." A spokeswoman for the NYPD stated at the time that it remained an "active and ongoing investigation."
